units.source_text: 有一天傍晚——约莫是二月上旬时，

en.t: One evening, probably in early February,

units.source_text: 良平带着小自己两岁的弟弟，还有一个和弟弟一般大小的邻居家的小孩，

en.t: Ryohei took along his younger brother, who was two years younger than he was, and a neighbor's child about the same age as his brother,

units.source_text: 一起到停着矿车的村边去。

en.t: and went with them to the edge of the village where the mine carts stood.

units.source_text: 矿车粘满了泥巴并排列在昏暗的暮光之中。

en.t: The mine carts were caked with mud and lined up in the dim twilight.

units.source_text: 除了这些矿车之外，工人们都不知所踪。

en.t: Apart from those carts, the workers were nowhere to be seen.

units.source_text: 三个孩子战战兢兢地去推最边上的一辆矿车。

en.t: The three children timidly went to push the cart at the very end.

units.source_text: 三个人合力一推，矿车突然“咕隆”一晃，车轮开始转动起来了。

en.t: When the three pushed together, the cart suddenly lurched with a rumble, and its wheels began to turn.

units.source_text: 这一声响吓得良平冒了一身冷汗。

en.t: The sound startled Ryohei so badly that he broke out in a cold sweat.

units.source_text: 但是车轮第二次发出“咕隆”的声响时，良平已经不再恐惧了。

en.t: But when the wheels rumbled a second time, Ryohei was no longer afraid.

units.source_text: “咕隆”，“咕隆”……三个人的手合力推着矿车，矿车也随着这声响缓缓地沿着轨道向上爬。

en.t: Rumble, rumble. As the three pairs of hands pushed the cart together, it too slowly climbed upward along the track with that sound.
